restrictions: Generic memoryless Pollard-rho (Floyd) on f(x)=Poseidon_r5(enc(x)||enc(0)), where enc is the canonical 32-byte LE Pallas encoding of x in F_p and Poseidon_r5 is poseidon-orchard-r5-prefix-v1 ConstantLength<2>; each evaluation is one selected-round permutation.
Both messages are distinct canonical 64-byte encodings nk||rho with rho=0 and nk in F_p; each is exactly two 32-byte little-endian Pallas field elements; full 256-bit digests (coordinate 0) agree.
At most 5*2^127 permutations plus <=80 field/word ops per evaluation at 1/321: T<2^129.64. Cap uses k=2^127 so that under H_random, Pr[L<=k]>=1-exp(-(k(k-1))/(2p)) with p the Pallas prime (~2^254).
Memory < 2^16 bytes. No tables/preprocessing/advice in the claimed algorithm.
Success >=0.3934 - 2^-127 under H_random (random-mapping first-repeat on F_p).

heuristics.statement: Let x0 be uniform in F_p and x_{i+1}=f(x_i). Let L be the first-repeat length. Assume Pr[L<=2^127] >= 1-exp(-(2^127*(2^127-1))/(2p)) >= 0.3934 and Pr[mu=0 and L<=2^127] <= 2^127/p < 2^-127, as for a uniform random mapping on F_p. Then success > 0.39 (proof.md).
heuristics.scope: One trajectory of f on F_p (~2^254 points) from a fresh uniform start; complete Orchard Poseidon with 5 partial rounds on messages (x,0).
heuristics.extrapolation: Organizer experiment rho-reduced runs Floyd on a 12-bit truncation of the same f (iterate trunc16(digest)); organizer checks digest bits 0..11 agree on returned distinct 64-byte messages. Extrapolated to full F_p. Poseidon-Orchard at 5 partial rounds has no published practical full collision that would make the first-repeat distribution of this f substantially worse than random.
heuristics.limitations: Assumption; 16-bit evidence only; generic attack; no algebraic structure of Poseidon is used.
